title: An Ant on the Clock: Exponential Escape Bounds for Langton's Ant
description:
An integer clock increasing by at least one per update gives square first exit by (13*3^(n-1)-2*n^2-4*n-5)/2, uniformly over initial colourings and internal poses, with arbitrary exterior colours. Its leading term is (13/6)*3^n. An anisotropic potential gives O_H(N^(floor(H/2)+1)) for fixed-height rectangles. The clock also gives decidable complete-state reachability, orbit equivalence and a computable orbit normal form.

Version 0.4.0 introduces the integer clock and reduces the leading square coefficient from 13/4 to 13/6. The analytic proofs are accompanied by exact algebraic checks and finite-state audits; the source archive retains Lean proofs of the related supercritical local clock lemmas.
